title: WorkspaceBundle
description:
A shareable workspace: layouts, palettes, pools, and appearance. Machine
and account state stays out, so a bundle travels as pure look.

version.description: Format version; a reader refuses a bundle from a newer format.

name.description: The bundle's name. Empty falls back to the file stem.

layouts.description: The layout presets, each a named dock dump.

panel_presets.description: The panel presets. In the bundle because they can name pool shaders.

primary_layout.description: The mini-player button's primary layout, by preset name.

palette_dark.description: Role name to `#rrggbb`. Empty means the designed defaults.

signals.description: The signal pool the looks route from. An apply replaces it wholesale.

shaders.description: The named WGSL the looks point into. An apply replaces it wholesale.

meta.description: Who made this workspace and what it is.

post_shader.description:
The whole-window shader. None applies as disabled, never as "leave
what's there".

backdrop_shader.description:
The shader over the backdrop and under the panels. None means a bare
backdrop.

NamedLayout.description:
A named dock layout preset. The dump stays raw JSON so the file loads
when the layout schema moves.

size.description: The window size the preset restores to. None keeps the current size.

LayoutSize.description: A window size in logical pixels.

PanelPreset.description:
A single configured panel saved under a name. Raw JSON keeps rox-core off
the dock crate.

Signal.description: One shared signal in the pool.

name.description: The user's name for it. Empty uses the label derived from the source.

smooth.description: Smoothing, 0 snaps to the music and 1 drifts. On onset and trigger, the pulse decay.

threshold.description:
The gate, 0 to 1 (0 is off): output under it is nothing, and above it
eases in through a smoothstep. On a trigger, the fire level instead.

reset_on_track.description: Aggregates only: drain to zero on a track change.

oneOf.description: Peak magnitude across a band, normalized into the dB window.
A pulse when the band jumps past its own recent average: a hit, where Band is a swell.

A pulse when the band crosses the threshold, re-armed once it falls back
under. Fires on a kick over sustained sub, where Onset arms once and goes quiet.

A running total of another signal, wrapping at 1: a phase a shader reads
as music-driven time, keeping its precision however long the app runs.

NamedShader.description:
One shader in a workspace's pool. The inline source is canonical; the
path is a local hot-reload bookmark that export scrubs.

name.description: Unique within a pool; the last entry wins on a repeat.

source.description: The fragment stage: a `fs_user(uv)` definition and whatever it calls.

path.description: The ejected working copy, for hot reload. None in exported bundles.

assets.description: The images the source declares with `// @asset`.

ShaderAsset.description:
One image a shader samples via `// @asset name: file`, stored in the
bundle as the encoded file in base64.

Assets never gate: approval is over code, and an image can't run anything
(ADR 23).

file.description: The flat filename the shader declares it under, also used by eject.

data.description: The encoded image file in base64.

WorkspaceMeta.description: The card on a workspace. Free text throughout; empty means unset.

description.description: What the look is going for.

version.description: The author's own version string, unrelated to the file format's.

created.description: When it was first exported, ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`.

updated.description: When it was last exported, same shape.

enabled.description: Whether the pass runs at all.

path.description: The WGSL fragment source file, absolute.

source.description:
The fragment stage inline, so it travels in a bundle. Empty falls back
to reading `path` at startup.

name.description:
A pool entry by name, which wins over the inline source. A name that
resolves to nothing runs nothing.

all_windows.description:
Whether child windows get the shader too. The confirm dialog stays
bare either way, so a hostile shader can't hide the way out.

routes.description:
Signal routes into the sixteen slots. Empty fills signal i into slot
i; any route replaces that fill, so unrouted slots read zero.

manual.description:
Hand-set slot values, read where nothing is routed. A route on the
same slot wins.

run_when_idle.description:
Keep drawing while the audio is silent. The clock only advances with
the signal feed either way.

Route.description: One signal driving one parameter. Unknown targets and missing signals are skipped.

enabled.description: Off keeps it in place, tuned, silent.

signal.description: The pool signal this route reads.

target.description: The parameter this drives, an id the host panel defines.

from.description:
The span, as fractions of the target's range: value at silence, value at
full signal. Inverted modulates downward.

AppearanceBundle.description:
The appearance knobs a workspace carries. The theme pick and font size
stay out: they're the user's own choices.

surface_opacity.description: How opaque the app's surfaces read, 0 to 1 (ADR 10).

backdrop_strength.description: How strongly the backdrop shows behind the surfaces, 0 to 1.

backdrop_all_windows.description: Whether child windows paint the cover backdrop too.

frame.description: The frame defaults every panel inherits, in px.

seams.description: Whether the 1px seams between panels paint. Off still resizes.

art_theming.description: Whether the playing track's art re-tints the palette (ADR 10).

keep_theme.description: Keep song theming from swapping between light and dark.

app_font.description: The app-wide font family. None follows the platform default.

rating_dots.description: Whether unfilled star slots draw a faint dot.

milkdrop.description:
The Milkdrop backdrop's look. Per-machine state lives in
[`BackdropVisualConfig`].

hide_menubar.description: Hide the menubar except while alt is held or a menu is open.

menubar_buttons.description: Which of the bar's status-side buttons show.

os_decorations.description: Whether the main windows get the OS's own titlebar and borders.

bare_child_windows.description: Whether child windows go bare too while `os_decorations` is off.

child_titlebar.description: Whether those bare child windows draw the fallback titlebar.

chrome_style.description: How the fallback titlebar's buttons draw.

chrome_side.description: Which end of the fallback titlebar the buttons sit at.

resize_border.description: Whether bare windows resize from their edges. Windows only.

Frame.description:
ADR 13's frame knobs in px, the defaults every panel's `PanelTheme` can
override.

Sides.description: A frame knob's four sides in px: one number while linked, per-side once split

RatingStyle.description:
Five stars or a 0-10 number in half steps, both over the library's 0-100
value.

QuickPlayConfig.description: How the quick-play modal draws its result list.

show_cover.description: Show a cover thumbnail at the left of each result.

show_subtitle.description: Show the artist and album line under each title.

show_duration.description: Show each result's duration on the right.

comfortable.description: Give each result row more height.

MilkdropLook.description: The Milkdrop backdrop's share of a look.

enabled.description: Whether the visual runs at all.

strength.description: The pass's alpha over the blurred cover, 0 to 1.

color.description: How the frame's colours meet the theme.

flip_horizontal.description: Mirror the frame left to right.

flip_vertical.description: Mirror the frame top to bottom.

MilkdropColor.description: How a Milkdrop frame's colours are treated before they reach the screen.

oneOf.description: The preset's own colours, whatever the theme.
The preset's own colours, lightness inverted on the light theme.
Lightness mapped onto a ramp from the theme's background to its accent.

A ramp through the playing cover's dominant colour, or the accent
while nothing plays.

MenubarButtons.description: Which of the menubar's status-side buttons draw.

ChromeStyle.description: Rox's own window buttons: flat icons or macOS traffic lights.

ChromeSide.description: Which end of the fallback titlebar the buttons sit at.
